cost_assessment.available_resource: one A100 or A30, or local Mac
cost_assessment.paper_configuration: 原文每次真实训练评估需数小时到数天，一次研究约10–25个trial、通常并行4–8个，并依赖私有feature outcomes、fleet预算服务和生产模型。完整活动不适合本轮一张A100/A30或Mac预算。仅CPU显式输入组件，预期三seed不足30秒，零模型/数据下载、零API。
cost_assessment.model_scale: Real trial evaluation takes hours to days; a session contains about10–25 trials with4–8 concurrent jobs, private feature outcomes, fleet budget services and production rankers. The complete campaign exceeds one A100/A30 or Mac budget. Explicit-input CPU primitives should take under30seconds across three seeds, with no model/data downloads or API calls.
cost_assessment.estimated_cost_basis: Fixed source and measured paper configuration; no local complete-campaign timing or costly probe.
cost_assessment.decision: 成本过高，不复现（审查 DONE）；仅低成本组件/接口

summary: Meta把特征创建、FI估计、跨任务Pareto分层、多来源混合和有约束搜索连成fleet级流程。LLM提出假设，确定性工具验证；每个模型同时面对自身serving限制和跨模型共享的上游pipeline预算。另一个模型已经使用某特征时，新增使用不一定新增pipeline成本。 仅实现Pareto层、显式quota混合、集合依赖pipeline差值、删除/同类别补回原语和已完成validation trial准入。FI、成本oracle、删除顺序、训练与资源测量都为外部输入。不运行LLM feature proposer、FI估计、异步研究搜索或生产发布；这是CPU机制合同，不是完整Agent优化系统。

online_ab_review.limits: Volume-only search evaluated; mixture tuning not evaluated; no attribution beyond reported fleet campaign.
